originalFailure: Existing authoring.spec host test waited for retired data-additional-tools and timed out.
migration: Current editor: opt-in character/choice/branch, current cut text and chapter settings, real asset selection, StageComposition resolution, explicit flow change, file export/import/reload.

validation.command: KNOL_TEST_STATIC=1 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/authoring.spec.ts --project=host --grep "blank authoring saves a real-asset branching work"
validation.scope: 3 cuts, background and resolved left actor, exact choice destination and endings, file export, overwrite draft, import independent copy, reload and whole project equality
validation.firstMigrationFailure: Import opens work preparation; currentFlow now returns to current cut and re-enables optional choice/branch tools before inspecting.
validation.phoneSoakUnaffected: Only browser test file changed; product source and static output unchanged.

limits: Focused host and native tests; not a complete product or release verification
Physical device, other devices and accessibility are separate

nativeValidation.command: KNOL_TEST_STATIC=1 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/authoring.spec.ts --project=stories-runtime --grep "newly authored branching work renders"
nativeValidation.scope: Created 3-cut branching work using current UI; actual illustrated RenPy canvas, each choice clicked using native measured geometry, exact destination and ending, current cut editing return and full manuscript equality, same iframe.
nativeValidation.boundary: One scoped native test; other old authoring paths not migrated.

storageRetryValidation.command: KNOL_TEST_STATIC=1 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/authoring.spec.ts --project=host --grep "explicit save retries a failed device write"
storageRetryValidation.scope: Simulated browser temporary-storage quota failure; current draft retained, explicit temporary-storage retry after restoring storage, reload preserves text.
storageRetryValidation.serverLog: Local static server emitted BrokenPipe after browser closed; test passed. No network or filesystem failure claim.

corruptStorageValidation.command: KNOL_TEST_STATIC=1 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/authoring.spec.ts --project=host --grep "corrupt stored workspace preserves raw bytes"
corruptStorageValidation.scope: Unreadable stored bytes remain unchanged; draft exports intact; importing another work and returning to library are blocked while the current draft remains visible.
corruptStorageValidation.boundary: One host test; does not establish physical device recovery.

structuralValidation.command: KNOL_TEST_STATIC=1 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/authoring.spec.ts --project=host --grep "blank creation preserves existing work"
structuralValidation.scope: Preserved a separate existing work; created current branching work, added and removed choices, made a new branch chapter, moved and deleted cuts, checked choice IDs and destinations, reopened both saved works and checked full project equality.
structuralValidation.boundary: Host UI and temporary storage; not a physical device or comprehensive test.

pendingMessageRegression.finding: Returning to library with unreadable temporary storage retains the current draft and explains saving a work file or recovering storage without showing raw Error text.
pendingMessageRegression.scope: Host corrupt-storage scenario; raw storage and exported manuscript equality preserved.

shelfSearchValidation.scope: Phone-sized host viewport: composing Enter retains panel and query, regular Enter closes panel, then matching book opens.
shelfSearchValidation.physicalScope: S25 Chrome portrait: CDP Enter, matching cover click, original editor return and full project equality. Not an OS IME test.
